title: Genealogy_Document_Definitions
description: Definitions for documentary sources, media scans, clipping coordinates, and transcripts.

source_media.description: Derivative scan image metadata and legibility assessment for an archival source record.

news_clipping.description: Physical clipping segment metadata linking visual scans to page and layout positions.

page.description: Page number or identifier where the clipping appears.

column.description: Column number or layout position on the page.

image_filename.description: Specific visual scan file name corresponding to this clipping segment.

transcript_record.description: Structured transcript container providing verbatim text, abstract, and file linkages.

verbatim_text.description: Literal historical transcription of the document text.

word_count.description: Total count of words in verbatim_text.

transcript_filename.description: Optional derivative filename of the standalone text file.

summary.description: Comprehensive abstract or factual summary of the content.

keywords.description: Indexed terms, topics, organizations, or search tags.
